'''Vogg Barakk''' was a [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who sent a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] on a collision course with the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. He was hired by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="DYD" />
